text_blocks.snippet: Aleve, which contains naproxen, is an NSAID (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug) that can be used to relieve minor aches, pains, and fever, including those that may be associated with COVID-19. However, Aleve is not indicated for the treatment or prevention of COVID-19. While public health authorities acknowledge that NSAIDs like Aleve can help with symptoms, they have not found evidence suggesting a link between NSAID use and worsened COVID-19 outcomes. It's always recommended to consult with a doctor or pharmacist for any questions or concerns regarding Aleve and COVID-19, according to Aleve.
